tips: Gybed 7 s after the mark, so its cost is in this number. Fine if it was for clear air or the favoured side; otherwise hold the lane until you're up to speed.
Took 71 s to settle upwind (best 25 s). Trim main and jib on through the turn, then speed before height.
Speed dropped 35% through the turn (5.81 → 3.8 kt; best 28%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
Passed 6 m from the mark. Wide in, tight out: leave it about a boat length (3 m) away on the exit.
